rows.question: The art room has 37 blue paper stars and 46 gold ones. How many paper stars are there altogether?
A trail crew marked 128 trees in one section and 95 in the next. How many trees did it mark?
A shuttle had 52 riders. At a stop, 17 got off and 9 got on. How many riders were aboard afterward?
A fundraiser has collected 275 dollars toward a 400-dollar goal. How many more dollars are needed?
A school orders 18 boxes of chalk, with 24 sticks in each box. How many sticks of chalk is that?
A seating chart has 16 rows with 28 chairs in each row. How many chairs are on the chart?
A print shop makes 35 posters for each of 17 classrooms. How many posters does it make?
A machine labels 42 jars each minute for 16 minutes. How many jars does it label?
A theater sets 14 rows of 26 seats, then blocks 18 seats for repairs. How many seats can be used?
A tank contains 64 liters of water. One eighth of the original water is used in the morning and one quarter of the original water in the afternoon. How many liters are used in all?
A school has 240 students. Twenty-five percent walk to school. How many students walk?
A drink mix uses 4 cups of water for every 1 cup of syrup. How many cups of water are needed for 3 cups of syrup?
A club has girls and boys in a 5:3 ratio, with 64 children total. How many more girls than boys are there?
A model uses 6 blue beads for every 4 yellow beads. If 30 blue beads are used, how many yellow beads are needed?
A classroom has 12 left-handed students and 18 right-handed students. Write the ratio of left-handed to all students as a simplified fraction.
A printer produces 315 pages in 7 minutes. How many pages does it print per minute?
A faucet fills a bucket at 8 liters per minute for 12 minutes. How many liters flow into the bucket?
A train travels 72 kilometers at 24 kilometers per hour. How many hours does the trip take?
A player scores 12, 16, 18, and 14 points in four rounds. What is the mean score?
A garden grows 3, 5, 4, 6, and 7 centimeters over five weeks. What is the average growth per week?
The average of four quiz scores is 82. Three scores are 78, 85, and 80. What is the fourth score?
Four hikes are 6, 8, 7, and 11 kilometers long. What is their average length?
A museum gets 240, 280, and 320 visitors on three days. What is the mean number of visitors per day?
Six equal-price markers cost 9 dollars total. What is the average cost per marker?
A ribbon is 275 centimeters long. How many meters is that?
A parcel has a mass of 3400 grams. What is its mass in kilograms?
A jug contains 1850 milliliters of water. How many liters is that?
A hallway is 4.2 meters long. How many centimeters long is it?
A bag of rice has a mass of 2.75 kilograms. How many grams is that?
A park trail is 3.6 kilometers long. How many meters is that?
A repair starts at 08:45 and ends at 12:15 on the same day. How many minutes pass?
A rectangular rug is 6 meters long and 4 meters wide. What is its area?
A square tile has a side length of 9 centimeters. What is its area?
A square sign has sides 18 centimeters long. What is its perimeter?
A rectangle has an area of 96 square meters and a width of 8 meters. What is its length?
A 5-by-8 meter patio is joined to a 3-by-8 meter patio without overlap. What is their total area?
A rectangular notice board measures 2.5 meters by 1.2 meters. What is its perimeter?
A student can choose one of 4 shirts and one of 3 pairs of pants. How many different shirt-and-pants outfits are possible?
A hiker has 3 trail choices from the cabin to a lake and 5 choices from the lake to a lookout. How many two-part routes are possible?
A library lists 4 workshops for children and 3 workshops for adults. How many workshops does it list in all?
A code uses one of 6 letters followed by one of 4 digits. How many different codes can be made?
Mira mailed 47 postcards in June and 39 in July. How many postcards did she mail during those months?
A long path is 92 meters and a short path is 68 meters. What is the difference in their lengths?
A notebook has 111 pages. Sam has already read 48 pages. How many pages are left to read?
A baker sets 8 trays on a counter with 12 cups on each tray. How many cups are there?
A pantry has 221 cans and places 13 cans on each shelf. How many shelves are filled?
Ava had $38, earned $27 for helping at a fair, and then spent $19. How much money does she have now?
A library storage room holds 320 books. It sends 86 books to one branch and 47 to another. How many books stay in storage?
A farmer gathered 275 apples, sold 68 at the market, and donated 39. How many apples remain?
A museum printed 450 maps. Visitors took 125 in the morning and 96 in the afternoon. How many maps are left?
A hiking group packed 198 snack bars. It handed out 57 before lunch and 64 afterward. How many bars are still packed?
A school ordered 620 notebooks, placed 184 in classrooms, then set aside 95 for an event. How many notebooks are neither placed nor set aside?
A mix contains only red and blue beads in a 2-to-3 ratio, with 30 beads altogether. How many beads are red?
A paint mix contains only yellow and white paint in a 3-to-5 ratio. If the batch contains 64 cups altogether, how many cups are yellow paint?
A 45-piece snack mix contains only nuts and dried fruit in a 4-to-1 ratio. How many pieces are nuts?
A bag has 72 white and black counters in a 5-to-7 ratio, white to black. How many are white?
A display contains only green and orange flags in a 3-to-2 ratio, with 55 flags total. How many flags are green?
A learner scored 72, 84, and 90 points on three quizzes. What is the average quiz score?
A workshop made 16, 20, and 21 birdhouses on three days. What was its average daily output?
The temperatures recorded at noon on three days were 12, 18, and 24 degrees Celsius. What was the average temperature?
A team scored 31, 34, and 38 goals in three games. How many goals per game did it average?
Three jars contain 14, 17, and 20 liters of paint. What is the average amount per jar?
A parcel has a mass of 2,500 grams. What is its mass in kilograms?
A jug contains 4,800 milliliters of juice. How many liters is that?
A roadwork crew paved 4,500 meters of road. How many kilometers is that?
Three identical tickets plus a $5 booking fee cost $50. What is the price of one ticket in dollars?
A cook uses 15 cups of broth, or 3/5 of the pot's original amount. How many cups were there at first?
Eighteen pages make up 1/6 of a workbook. How many pages are in the whole workbook?
A 120-row garden gives 1/4 of its rows to peas and 1/3 to beans. How many rows are left for other crops?
A cistern starts with 120 liters of water. It sends one-eighth of this starting water to the kitchen and one-fourth of this starting water to the greenhouse. How many liters remain?
A 84-meter roll is cut: 1/3 for a banner and 1/7 for a sign. How many meters are not used in those two pieces?
A rain tank starts with 240 liters of water. It sends two-fifths of this starting water to a garden and one-eighth of this starting water to a pond. How many liters are left in the tank?
Of 210 tickets, 4/7 go to students and 1/6 to staff. How many tickets remain for the public sale?
A pond contains 120 liters of water. A pump removes one-fourth of this water on its first pass, then one-third of what remains. How many liters does it remove on the second pass?
A 90-meter cable is shortened by 1/3, then a worker cuts 1/4 of the remaining cable. What is the length of that second cut?
A 100-cookie tray has 1/5 packed for one order. A second order takes 3/8 of the cookies left. How many cookies go in the second order?
A 144-page book has 1/3 read on Monday; on Tuesday, 1/4 of the unread pages are read. How many pages are read Tuesday?
A barrel contains 160 liters of water. It loses three-eighths of this water during a leak. Later, one-half of the remaining water is poured out. How many liters are poured out later?
A 210-tree orchard has 2/7 of its trees pruned first. A crew then finishes pruning 1/5 of the trees still waiting. How many trees are in that later group?
A 84-kilometer walk is divided so that the hikers complete 1/2 before lunch. They cover 1/3 of the remaining distance afterward. How many kilometers do they cover afterward?
A tank contains 252 liters. After 1/4 is used for washing, 2/9 of the water left is sent to a garden. How many liters go to the garden?
A bakery sets aside 2/5 of a 300-roll batch for morning sales. It donates 1/6 of the rolls still available. How many rolls are donated?
A 180-meter ribbon roll is trimmed by 1/6. A craft club uses 2/5 of the ribbon that remains. How many meters does the club use?
A 144-meter garden hose is cut by 1/3 for one job and then by 1/4 of the remaining hose for another. How many meters are left?
A 160-cookie batch has 3/8 packed for a cafe; of the cookies left, 1/5 are packed for a second shop. How many cookies remain unpacked?
A tank starts with 84 liters. A family uses 1/2, then uses 1/3 of the water still there. What volume remains?
A farmer sells 2/5 of 300 melons, then gives away 1/6 of the unsold melons. How many melons are neither sold nor given away?
A tank contains 500 liters of water. It sends 18 percent of this water to the greenhouse. How many liters go there?
A gardener planted 72 bulbs, equal to 60% of the garden plan. How many bulbs does the full plan call for?
A 48-page section is 40% of a guidebook. How many pages does the complete guidebook have?
Thirty-six kilometers represent 45% of a trail network. What is the network's total length?
Fifty-four seats are 15% of a hall's total seating. How many seats does the hall have?
A delivery of 132 jars is 55% of a store's order. How many jars were ordered?
A $250 chair is offered at 20% off. What is the reduced price?
A town garden counted 200 seedlings at the start of spring. The count rises by 10%, then falls by 10% after a dry week. How many seedlings remain?
A 600-page archive is expanded by 10 percent. Then 5 percent of all pages in the enlarged archive are removed as duplicates. How many pages remain?
A $120 desk is discounted 25%, then a 10% sales tax is applied to the sale price. What is the total cost?
A $80 lamp gets a 10% markdown before 5% tax is added. How much does the buyer pay in all?
A $48 board game is reduced by 12.5%, and a 10% tax is charged on the reduced price. What is the checkout total?
A $540 camera bundle has a 15% discount. A 4% tax is added after the discount. What does the customer pay?
A $200 printer is discounted by 12%, then taxed at 6%. What is the total after both changes?
A class sorts fiction books and science books in a 5:2 ratio. If the science shelf holds 18 books, how many fiction books are there?
A display divides 100 paper flowers among tulips, daisies, and poppies in the ratio 2:3:5. How many are daisies?
A team of 96 volunteers is assigned to setup, guiding, and cleanup in a 1:4:3 ratio. How many volunteers are assigned to setup?
A box contains only glass, wooden, and clay beads in a 3:2:4 ratio, with 81 beads altogether. How many are clay beads?
All 90 seats in a hall are assigned to local, visiting, or student guests in the ratio 5:2:3. How many seats are for local guests?
A maker sorts 100 fabric squares into cotton, linen, and felt piles in the ratio 4:1:5. How many squares go in the felt pile?
A craft board has stickers in counts with red:blue = 2:3 and blue:gold = 3:4. If there are 10 red stickers, how many gold stickers are there?
A snack display follows cracker:cheese-cube = 5:2 and cheese-cube:grape = 3:4. If it has 30 crackers, how many grapes does it have?
A textile pattern consists only of blue and orange squares in a 2:5 ratio. There are 21 more orange than blue squares. How many squares are in the pattern altogether?
A nature chart shows only oak and birch saplings in a 4:9 ratio. The birch count exceeds the oak count by 25. How many saplings are shown altogether?
A storage bin contains only short and long dowels in a 5:2 ratio. There are 18 more short dowels than long dowels. How many dowels are in the bin?
Originally, a display has blue and red tiles in a 2:3 ratio. Eight tiles are added to the blue group, making the new ratio 1:1. How many blue tiles were there before the addition?
A jar begins with silver and black buttons in a 4:7 ratio. Putting 18 more silver buttons in the jar changes the ratio to 2:3. How many silver buttons were there initially?
A color-coded supply has yellow:purple = 4:3. The total yellow-and-purple count to orange count is 7:5. If the yellow count is 24, what is the orange count?
A gardener pays $88 for 11 identical seed trays. How many dollars does each tray cost?
A hiker covers 12 kilometers in the first 2 hours and 18 kilometers in the next 3 hours. What is the average speed over the whole hike?
A hose fills a storage barrel at 7 liters per minute for 9 minutes. How many liters enter the barrel?
One trail crew clears 96 meters in 8 hours; another clears 135 meters in 9 hours. How many more meters per hour does the faster crew clear?
A reader finishes 105 pages in 5 hours, while a partner finishes 168 pages in 7 hours. How many more pages per hour does the partner read?
Nora read 12, 16, 19, and 21 pages during four short sessions. How many pages did she read per session on average?
Four parcels weigh 2, 4, 5, and 9 kilograms. What is their mean weight?
A plant grew 3, 5, and 7 centimeters over three measured weeks. What was its average weekly growth?
A game player earned 14, 18, 20, 24, and 24 points in five rounds. Find the mean score per round.
The average length of four ribbons is 18 centimeters. Three are 14, 17, and 21 centimeters long. How long is the fourth ribbon?
A set of five quiz scores has a mean of 16 points. Four scores are 12, 15, 17, and 19. What is the missing score?
Six jars contain an average of 11 marbles each. The first five hold 8, 9, 10, 12, and 13 marbles. How many marbles are in the last jar?
A baker used five batches of flour, averaging 4 kilograms per batch. Four batch amounts were 3, 4, 4, and 5 kilograms. How much flour was used in the fifth batch?
A student has scores of 72, 80, and 84 on three equally weighted quizzes. What score on a fourth quiz would make the four-quiz average 82?
A cyclist rode 18, 22, and 25 kilometers on three days. How far must the cyclist ride on day four for the four-day daily average to be 24 kilometers?
A team scored 6, 8, 10, and 12 goals across four games. How many goals in game five would bring its five-game average to 10 goals per game?
Three practice sessions lasted 35, 40, and 45 minutes. How long should a fourth session last to make the mean session length 42 minutes?

One reading group has 9 members who average 4 books read this term; another has 11 members averaging 6 books. How many books per member is the combined average? The two groups have no members in common.
A blend contains 25% concentrate rated at 12 units and 75% concentrate rated at 20 units. What is the blend’s weighted average rating?
A snack mix is 40% raisins rated at 6 sweetness units and 60% cereal rated at 11 units. What is the weighted average sweetness rating?
Plan A costs $8 plus $3 per visit. Plan B costs $20 plus $1 per visit. At how many visits do the plans cost the same?
A delivery service charges $5 plus $4 per box. Another charges $23 plus $1 per box. How many boxes make the two bills equal?
One gym membership costs $30 plus $2 per class. A pass at another gym costs $12 plus $5 per class. After how many classes are the costs equal?
A parking lot charges $16 plus $2 per hour. A nearby lot charges $4 plus $5 per hour. For how many hours is the charge the same at both lots?
A box contains twice as many green tokens as yellow tokens. There are 39 tokens total. How many yellow tokens are there? The total consists only of green and yellow tokens.
A basket holds three times as many pears as apples, with 48 pieces of fruit altogether. How many apples are in the basket? The total consists only of pears and apples.
A display has five times as many small flags as large flags. There are 72 flags altogether. How many are large? The total consists only of small and large flags.
A class has four times as many fiction books as science books on a table, for 65 books total. How many are science books? The total consists only of fiction and science books.
A shop has 5 mug designs and 4 coaster designs. Every mug could pair with every coaster except for 3 combinations that are unavailable. How many gift pairings can be made?
A player may select one of 6 blue tokens, 4 red tokens, or 7 green tokens. How many individual token choices are there?
A four-symbol badge code uses one of 3 symbols in each position, and symbols may repeat. How many codes are possible?
A locker label has 3 letters followed by 2 digits. Each letter position has 4 available letters, each digit position has 5 available digits, and repeats are allowed. How many labels can be made?
A five-bead bracelet pattern is recorded as an ordered sequence. Each position can be any of 2 colors, including colors used earlier. How many sequences are possible?
A three-character access tag is made from 2 available letters followed by one of 6 icons. Repetition is allowed in the letter positions. How many tags are possible?
A rectangular garden covers 84 m² and is 7 m wide. How long is the garden?
The area of a rectangular poster is 216 cm². If its height is 12 cm, what is its length?
A rectangular floor has an area of 54 m² and a width of 4.5 m. Find its length.
A banner is rectangular and covers 90 cm². Its short side is 6 cm. How long is the other side?
A rectangular animal pen has area 176 m² and width 8 m. What is its length?
The perimeter of a rectangular card is 70 cm. Its length is 22 cm. Find its width.
A rug is 8 m by 6 m; a smaller mat is 7 m by 5 m. How many more square meters does the rug cover? All objects in this question are rectangles with the stated side lengths.
A large rectangular sheet is 35 cm by 22 cm. A smaller sheet is 30 cm by 20 cm. Find the difference in area.
A project uses two rectangular fabric panels: one is 65 cm by 40 cm and the other is 30 cm by 25 cm. What is their total area?
A 36 m by 24 m rectangular lawn contains a 12 m by 8 m rectangular pond. How many square meters of lawn remain outside the pond?
A rectangular sign board is 120 cm by 80 cm. Its rectangular window is 50 cm by 30 cm. Find the board area outside the window.
A rectangular garden is 22 ft by 8 ft, with a 2 ft opening for a gate. Find the length of fence used.
A 31 m by 17 m rectangular animal pen has a 4 m gate opening. How much fencing encloses the boundary aside from the gate?
A rectangular patio is 6.5 m by 4.5 m, and one 1.5 m section is left open for a gate. How much edging is installed?
A rectangular courtyard is 19 m long and 11 m wide. If its boundary has a 5 m gate opening, how many meters of fence are needed?
A classroom floor is 800 cm by 600 cm. Rectangular tiles are 40 cm by 30 cm and fit exactly with no gaps or cuts. How many tiles cover the floor?
A rectangular patio measures 900 cm by 600 cm. It is tiled with 30 cm by 30 cm squares, with no gaps or cutting. How many tiles are used?
A rectangular counter top is 240 cm by 100 cm. It is covered exactly by 20 cm by 20 cm square tiles. How many tiles cover it?
Two 4 m-wide rectangular mats, 8 m and 5 m long, are joined end to end along their 4 m sides without overlap. What is the perimeter of the new rectangle?
A 3.5 m by 2 m rectangle is placed end to end with a 4.5 m by 2 m rectangle along the matching 2 m sides. What is the perimeter of the combined rectangle?
A 22 m by 5 m garden strip is extended end to end by an 11 m by 5 m strip. Their 5 m edges meet exactly. What is the perimeter of the resulting rectangle?
A cyclist rides 2 full laps around a rectangular route that is 1.2 km by 0.5 km. How many kilometers does the cyclist cover?
One lap around a rectangular course measuring 320 m by 180 m follows its entire boundary. How far are 5 laps?
Rectangle A is 12 m by 5 m, while Rectangle B is 9 m by 7 m. By how many meters is A’s perimeter greater?
A rectangular rug is 8 ft by 4.5 ft and a mat is 6 ft by 5 ft. What is the difference between their perimeters, rug minus mat?
A room plan gives rectangular dimensions of 515 cm and 285 cm. What is the room’s perimeter in meters?
A rectangular plot has a 42 m length; its width is 18 m shorter. Calculate its area.
A 18 m by 7 m rectangular bed needs edging all around. If each roll covers 10 m, how many rolls are required?
A rectangular patio is 7.5 m by 4.5 m. One roll contains 6 m of edging. How many rolls exactly cover its perimeter?
A train ride begins at 06:38 on the same day and lasts 142 minutes. At what minute after midnight does it finish?
The city loop leaves every 15 minutes from 08:00 through 09:00 on the same day, including departures at both stated times. How many departures are there?
A chime occurs every 10 minutes from 09:00 to 10:00 on the same day. How many occurrences fall strictly between the events at 09:00 and 10:00?
A bell occurs every 15 minutes from 11:15 to 12:15 on the same day. How many occurrences fall strictly between the events at 11:15 and 12:15?
A clock signal occurs every 20 minutes from 07:30 to 08:30 on the same day. How many occurrences fall strictly between the events at 07:30 and 08:30?
A water-level reading occurs every 15 minutes from 15:05 to 16:05 on the same day. How many occurrences fall strictly between the events at 15:05 and 16:05?
A traveler rides a 66-minute train, waits 24 minutes, then takes a 51-minute bus. How many minutes pass from the start of the first ride to the end of the bus ride?
A greenhouse worker works from 08:05 to 16:20 on the same day, with breaks of 30 and 15 minutes. How many minutes are spent working, excluding both breaks?
A museum guide is on shift from 09:12 to 17:02 on the same day, with breaks of 35 and 20 minutes. How many minutes are spent working, excluding both breaks?
A lab assistant works from 07:48 to 14:33 on the same day, with breaks of 25 and 10 minutes. How many minutes are spent working, excluding both breaks?
A camp counselor is scheduled from 08:30 to 15:45 on the same day, with breaks of 40 and 15 minutes. How many minutes are spent working, excluding both breaks?
A librarian is at work from 10:06 to 18:21 on the same day, with breaks of 30 and 25 minutes. How many minutes are spent working, excluding both breaks?
A flight itinerary lists a 64-minute first leg, a 91-minute second leg, and a 23-minute third leg. What is the total time aboard the aircraft?
A cyclist starts from the park at 15:10 on the same day. The trip has two legs lasting 32 and 67 minutes, with no stop between them. At what minute after midnight does the trip end?
On the same day, the first part of a train and a ferry ends at 11:07 and the next begins at 11:52. How many minutes are between them?
A sample of clay has a mass of 375 grams. Express it in kilograms. (1 kilogram = 1,000 grams.)
A crate contains 12,050 grams of soil. How many kilograms of soil is that? (1 kilogram = 1,000 grams.)
A sack of grain has a mass of 65,000 grams. How many kilograms is that? (1 kilogram = 1,000 grams.)
A jug holds 2,250 milliliters. Express its capacity in liters. (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters.)
A water barrel contains 15,300 milliliters. How many liters is that? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters.)
A screen is 5 inches wide. What is its width in centimeters? (Use 1 inch = 2.54 centimeters.)
A dispenser has 0.75 liter of soap, then receives 80 milliliters more. How many milliliters are there now? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters.)
A reservoir sample begins at 6.25 liters; 125 milliliters are removed. How many milliliters remain? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters.)
A storage bin holds 12 kilograms of rice, then 4,800 grams are poured in. What is the resulting mass in grams? (1 kilogram = 1,000 grams.)
A drone flies 0.8 kilometer and then 75 meters farther. How far has it gone in kilometers? (1 kilometer = 1,000 meters.)
A race course has a 4.05-kilometer section and a 950-meter section. Find the combined distance in kilometers. (1 kilometer = 1,000 meters.)
A pitcher containing 1,800 milliliters of lemonade is divided evenly among 6 identical jars. How many milliliters go in each jar?
A 2,250-milliliter batch of soup is poured equally into 5 containers. What volume goes into each container, in milliliters?
A 1,440-milliliter drink is shared equally among 12 flasks. How many milliliters does each flask hold?
A filter processes 18 liters of water per hour. Express the rate in milliliters per minute. (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters; 1 hour = 60 minutes.)
A cord weighs 20 grams per meter. What is the mass in kilograms of 0.75 kilometer of cord? (1 kilometer = 1,000 meters; 1 kilogram = 1,000 grams.)
A makerspace has $360 for badge kits. It orders 8 cartons at $24 each and 6 marker sets at $7 each. How many dollars remain?
From a $275 supply envelope, a scout leader pays $19 for each of 5 rope bundles and $11 each for 4 lanterns. What is the balance?
A school club sets aside $420 for a trip. It buys 9 shuttle passes at $32 apiece plus a $36 map order; what is left in the fund?
The prop crew starts with $198. After buying 7 foam boards for $13 each and three tape rolls at $6 each, how much cash is left?
A delivery crew reserves $510 for supplies. Fuel cans cost $38 each, and the crew buys 8 cans and a $14 box of gloves. How many dollars remain?
A workshop shelf holds 35 labels. Six cartons arrive with 12 labels in each, then 28 labels are used. How many labels stay on the shelf?
There are 40 clips in a dispatch drawer. A delivery adds 7 packs of 9 clips, and the team uses 22 clips. How many remain?
A print room begins the day with 18 paper rolls, receives 4 cartons containing 16 rolls apiece, and sends 31 rolls to another room. Find its remaining rolls.
The depot had 52 tags. Five replenishment boxes brought 14 tags each; after 47 tags went out with orders, what quantity is left?
A club has 27 reusable cups, unpacks 8 sleeves of 11 cups, then lends 36 cups to a neighboring club. How many cups can it still use?
The event team combines 125 blue badges with 175 green badges, then places them into packets of 15. How many full packets are there?
A warehouse picks 12 crates holding 8 meters of cable each and adds 48 loose meters. The cable is cut into 12-meter kits. How many kits result?
A family buys 7 museum tickets at $18 each. A $16 booking charge is added, then a $25 credit is applied. What is the final cost?
Four theater passes cost $27 apiece, and the order has a $12 service fee. A $20 voucher reduces the bill. How many dollars are due?
For a science-fair visit, a school purchases 9 entry tickets priced at $11 each and pays an $8 group charge. It uses a $15 credit. Find the net ticket bill.
A concert group takes 6 seats at $21 each. The online order includes $14 in fees and a $30 coupon. What amount does the group pay?
A recreation center issues 5 day tickets at $32 each, adds an $18 reservation fee, and subtracts a $25 discount. What is the final charge?
A depot plans to issue 84 batteries and still finish with 480 batteries in stock. It has 125 now. How many batteries should the incoming order provide?
The mail room wants 90 padded envelopes left after sending out 19. With 28 on the shelf now, what number should be delivered?
A $980 event budget has $260 reserved for the hall. The remaining dollars are divided equally among 6 activity crews. How much does each crew receive?
A school trip has $1,240 available, of which $340 covers the bus. The rest is shared equally by 9 chaperone groups. How many dollars go to each group?
A $1,080 travel pool pays a fixed $360 parking bill, then gets split evenly among 8 drivers. What is each driver’s amount?
A print shop combines 132 blue sheets and 188 white sheets. It discards 40 torn sheets, then bundles the remainder in groups of 14. How many complete bundles result?
A shipment has 288 small tags and another has 192. Eighty damaged tags are removed before workers pack the good ones 25 to a sleeve. How many sleeves can they fill?
Seven trucks can each carry 45 crates. With 186 crates already loaded and 35 slots reserved for fragile items, how many open crate spaces remain?
A fleet of 8 vans has room for 32 boxes apiece. The dispatch team has assigned 176 boxes and holds 16 places for late parcels. How many spaces are still unassigned?
Each of 6 carts can take 28 supply bins. Once 120 bins are loaded, 12 spots are set aside for returns. How many ordinary bin slots are left?
A venue’s 9 storage racks hold 24 cases each. Workers place 150 cases on them and reserve 18 empty slots for urgent arrivals. How many other case slots are open?
Five delivery wagons each have room for 40 cartons. The crew loads 137 cartons and keeps 13 places free for returns. Count the remaining general-use places.
A school sends 12 classrooms a box of 14 pencils each and 8 classrooms a box of 11 markers each. How many writing tools are sent?
A loading plan called for 9 carts with 24 parcels on each. The crew actually loaded 190 parcels. How many fewer parcels than planned went aboard?
A warehouse has 420 small boxes and receives another 180. After 120 are set aside for returns, the remainder goes evenly to 12 loading bays. How many boxes per bay?
A storeroom has 88 cable ties and will use 25 on repairs and 17 on packing. It wants 150 left afterward. How many cable ties should be ordered?
The venue has 120 seat tags. It plans to give out 35 at registration and 25 to staff, while keeping 200 in reserve. What delivery quantity is required?
A dispatch room holds 64 padded bags; 18 will ship with fragile items and 22 with documents. To have 130 bags afterward, how many must arrive?
A classroom has 92 blank cards. It will use 28 for labels and 24 for signs, but plans to retain 160 cards. How many cards must be delivered?
A $1,260 travel budget pays $300 for a bus and $240 for fuel. The rest is split evenly across 6 drivers. How many dollars can each driver spend on meals?
The school sets aside $1,500 for trip expenses, then pays $420 for buses and $360 for entry. The balance is assigned equally to 8 classrooms. How many dollars does each classroom receive?
A supply drive raises $990. Organizers spend $270 on boxes and $180 on labels before dividing what remains among 9 packing teams. Find the dollar amount per team.
Out of 120 pages, 3/4 of the 120 pages are colored. Then 2/3 of those colored are annotated. How many pages satisfy both conditions?
Out of 150 cards, 4/5 of the 150 cards are blue. Then 1/2 of those blue are laminated. How many cards satisfy both conditions?
Out of 180 beads, 7/9 of the 180 beads are glass. Then 3/7 of those glass are strung. How many beads satisfy both conditions?
A garden path has 96 meters at the start. One task uses 1/4 of the original 96 meters, and another uses 3/8 of the same original amount. How many meters are used altogether?
A page stack has 144 sheets at the start. One task uses 5/12 of the original 144 sheets, and another uses 1/3 of the same original amount. How many sheets are used altogether?
